Medium.description: A list of 6 medium difficulty questions: 2 MCQ, 2 Code Snippet, and 2 DSA.

Hard.description: A list of 6 hard difficulty questions: 2 MCQ, 2 Code Snippet, and 2 DSA (DSA must combine at least two topics).

Ultra Hard.description: A list of 6 ultra hard difficulty questions: 2 MCQ, 2 Code Snippet, and 2 DSA (DSA must combine ALL topics).
